item.title: Shot Reporter 0.2.0-alpha.4
item.description:
Shot Reporter 0.2.0-alpha.4 — Mac alpha update

This Mac alpha advances the desktop build for authenticated update testing. It keeps the desktop reporting and footage workflow from the previous alpha.

Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later are supported. Installations require confirmation and a saved report before Shot Reporter closes and relaunches.

Reports, history, preferences, media journals and source footage keep their existing locations. Finish active media operations and resolve recovery or import messages before installing.

Update feeds and downloads require the dedicated Shot Reporter signatures. The Mac sandbox remains enabled. RAW helpers and vendor runtimes remain separately installed and locally authorized.

The reporting-only release and earlier manual-only desktop alphas require one manual installation of an updater-enabled build.

Acceptance-only testing limits: native older-to-newer installation/relaunch, save/recovery refusal, and external RAW picker reopening are not yet accepted for this candidate. This prerelease must remain unpromoted until those checks pass.
